requirements.requirement: 公開移行の preflight・排他・read-only
outcomeToConditionReview: Inspect, dry-run and already-current no-op avoid creating project state. Apply rechecks source and control generations under RepositoryMaintenanceLock. Read-only managed execution uses external owned scratch.

Closed sibling stages and exact before-images bind preparation, publication and readback. Cold recovery resumes owned unfinished effects. The durable cleanup cutoff restricts later work to evidence retirement. Foreign bytes, paths and generations refuse.

requirements.requirement: Specs と真正な直前 producer からの明示 migration
implementationBoundaries: Public Specs migration registry1..6; canonicalFlow schema5; explicit Runtime8/9->10 before process-evidence conversion whenrequired
outcomeToConditionReview: Explicit public migration validates genuine previous-producer bytes, preserves original evidence and semantic history, and strictly reads the current form. Dormant history and old grants do not acquire new execution authority.

requirements.requirement: Repair identity・Git logical mode と raw source の分離
outcomeToConditionReview: Raw content digests remain independent of UTF-8 presentation and native permission hints. Git logical modes, flags and physical controls are captured through their shared acquisition boundaries. Same-byte replacements remain distinct physical generations.

requirements.requirement: 独立 Git restore stage と既存 rollback の接続
outcomeToConditionReview: The independent Git stage isolates index, objects, refs, EOL and configuration. Exact raw readback and Git-visible mode are required before a restore capability is minted. Prepared/published per-path receipts connect live rollback and cold recovery without duplicate effects.

requirements.requirement: 正規の非 Git source の保存・再読込・復元
outcomeToConditionReview: A selected regular non-Git root uses raw kind, bytes and generation throughout save, reload and restore. Git command failure preserves the typed failure. Missing paths, blocked descendants and directories retain their separate representations.

requirements.requirement: 保存形式・digest・strict codec と後続 consumer
implementationBoundaries: Runtime records10; currentprocess-evidence leaves and permanentoriginalproducer encodingproofs
Canonical Store and existing Source handoff persistence
outcomeToConditionReview: Current strict formats cover Flow5, Runtime10, Source2, TaskSource2 and RepairFingerprint4 plus independently versioned process evidence. Original producer encoding preserves event and receipt identity through explicit migration. Shared Store/readback consumers use those same codecs.

requirements.requirement: 未使用 offline migration transaction の削除
outcomeToConditionReview: The unused production offline migration transaction is deleted. Existing typed migration and file-authority modules own the effects. Test-only historical producers and snapshots remain in tests/support and fixtures.

requirements.requirement: 共通 retry・recovery 契約と停止・再開の保証
implementationBoundaries: Existing finite FileLock and process completion boundary
No unknown owner reclamation or new native budget
outcomeToConditionReview: Finite execution/control budgets and existing retry/recovery ownership remain intact. Unknown native completion retains evidence and exclusion. The exact parent Source ProcessExecutionControlFailure now reaches shared failure selection before content-error conversion. Freeze-proof expiration changes in-memory work only.
